asc_inceleme_notu_en: Version 1.73: new Social tab (friends + clubs; clubs are joined with a 6-letter invite code). When friends or club members ride together, a joint 3D video is generated on the device. The entire app is free. The only in-app purchases are three optional consumable tips (com.nickdegs.kisisel.bagis.kucuk / .orta / .buyuk) under Profile > Support us; they unlock no features or content. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use links are on the tip screen. Sign in with Apple to test.
